content: Smart pathogen control Sustainable Mold Control in Modern Feed Production Current feed systems struggle with moisture, long storage, and inconsistent ingredient quality, which foster bacterial and fungal growth. These pathogens produce mycotoxins, harmful metabolites that ruin feed quality and threaten animal health. As the industry shifts toward antibiotic-free and residue-free standards, there is an urgent need for natural, sustainable ways to manage these risks and ensure safe nutrition. Challenges Inconsistent mold control, especially against resilient or highly resistant fungal strains. Incomplete fungal suppression, resulting in recurring growth cycles and microbial flare-ups. Risk of nutrient depletion and a decline in the palatability of animal feed. Weak defenses against specific fungi known for producing hazardous mycotoxins. Rising concerns over chemical residues, operator safety, and ecological footprints. Persistent pathogen threats, such as Salmonella and E. coli, increasing the risk of infection. Escalating antimicrobial resistance, making surviving microorganisms significantly more difficult to neutralize. MaxDmold™ Plus is a cutting-edge feed TM hygiene innovation, utilizing bioavailable phyto-actives enhanced through mineral MaxDmold complexation. This synergistic blend provides powerful broad-spectrum defense against bacteria and fungi. It guarantees Plus effective feed decontamination and preserves vital nutrients through a completely natural approach.
